name: Harbor House AI Receptionist Demo
description: A fictional, static A2A DESIGN demonstration of a disclosed AI receptionist for Bournemouth and Dorset businesses. Skills simulate answering business questions, scheduling requests, qualification and human handover; no live phone, CRM or calendar transaction is exposed.

skills.name: Answer a business question
skills.description: Answer a routine question using the fictional Harbor House knowledge base.
skills.output: A cautious answer or a request for human follow-up.

skills.name: Check business hours
skills.description: Return the published simulated opening hours.
skills.output: Opening hours and a human-availability note.

skills.name: Request appointment slots
skills.input: Service type and preferred date or time window.
skills.output: Candidate slot(s), clearly labelled as simulated.

skills.name: Create a booking request
skills.description: Prepare a simulated booking request after the caller confirms a slot.
skills.output: A booking request summary; no live booking is made.

skills.name: Qualify a new enquiry
skills.description: Capture the intent and useful context for a first enquiry.
skills.output: Intent, context and suggested next step.

skills.name: Request human handover
skills.description: Prepare a concise context summary for a human team member.
skills.input: Caller request or situation requiring judgement.

skills.name: Get service information
skills.description: Return cautious information about a fictional Harbor House service.
skills.output: Service information without an invented quote.

skills.name: Create a callback request
skills.description: Prepare a simulated callback for the relevant team.
skills.input: Caller name, intent and preferred callback window.
skills.output: Callback request summary; no message is sent.

authentication.description: No authentication is required for this static design demonstration.

endpoints.description: Human-facing demonstration and Agent Card only; no remote A2A service endpoint is claimed.

contact.note: The demo keeps human handover visible and does not impersonate a person.
